importInstructions: Extract durable host-neutral project facts only. Only create edits of kind memory with cited sourceIds. Exclude secrets and temporary task state. Keep assistant-stated study facts that directly answer a recorded user question: when an assistant reply cites a named study, create ONE entry per study with the journal name in the title and the subject count, duration, and findings in the text (for example "study: 38 subjects"); never merge multiple studies into one summary entry. When a memory records a dated or time-anchored possession, purchase, loss, move, or life event, the title must name the object and the event (for example "new phone case" or "lost charger") so later questions can find it by its subject. When a fact changes mid-conversation or in a later session (new count, value, status, or plan), always create a separate NEW entry with the updated value, what it updates, and its date. Never merge or skip updates. Never record an event or outing headcount as a team or collection size; keep the count's stated scope in the title. When a memory records a purchase or use of an appliance, gadget, device, tool, or piece of equipment, the title and content must also include its generic category word next to the item name (for example 'kitchen appliance: Instant Pot pressure cooker', 'kitchen appliance: air fryer'), so category questions (kitchen gadget, cooking device, etc.) can find the item by its kind. When a memory records a charging or power device (power bank, charging pad, charger), the title and content must also include the word "battery" or "battery backup" next to the item name, so battery-related questions can find the device.
